author: iwannareview
quote:
This game could potentially have an absolutely killer online mode, but this ain't it bro.

Rockstar has been incredibly anti-consumer building up to the launch of this game, and it turns out it's not even that good to justify their behaviour. 

Story worse than rdr2, but also lackluster compared to older GTA titles. The main characters are honestly dog**** and the whole game just lacks the personality that made GTA what it is.

Now, you can have fun in this game, playing around with the NPCs and the sandbox mechanics, using Lucia and Jason as fashion puppets and whatever else, but that's what online is for... something we STILL don't have any news about. 

All in all, critics reviews are definitely bought out or at least forced to be this perfect, so I am being extra strict to make up for that :)
